strategies.name: Volatility Breakout
strategies.source: Larry Williams, Long-Term Secrets to Short-Term Trading (1999)
strategies.plain: Trade the day's first move beyond the open plus or minus part of yesterday's range.

strategies.name: Prior-Day High/Low Breakout
strategies.plain: Buy a break of yesterday's high, short a break of yesterday's low.

strategies.name: VWAP Reversion
strategies.plain: When the price is stretched far from VWAP, bet it comes back.

strategies.name: Bollinger Reversion (5-min)
strategies.source: John Bollinger, Bollinger on Bollinger Bands (2001)
strategies.plain: Fade 5-minute closes outside the Bollinger Bands until the price is back at the average.

strategies.name: Minute Channel Breakout
strategies.source: Richard Donchian / Turtle channel breakout (on minute bars)
strategies.plain: Go with any break of the last 30-120 minutes' high or low.

strategies.name: Late-Day Momentum
strategies.source: Baltussen, Da, Lammers & Martens (2021), Journal of Financial Economics
strategies.plain: If the market is up on the day by 15:00 or 15:30, buy into the close; if down, short.

strategies.name: Pre-FOMC Drift
strategies.plain: On Fed announcement days, buy in the morning and sell at 14:00, just before the statement.
